name: Full Body Production Render
instruction: Create one complete mature specimen in a neutral natural pose, shown in a three-quarter view with the entire wingspan or folded-wing silhouette fully visible.

name: Portrait
instruction: Create a museum-quality head and upper-body portrait emphasizing sensory organs, feeding anatomy, feather or membrane detail, and natural expression.

name: Orthographic Front
instruction: Create an exact front orthographic view with symmetrical alignment and no perspective distortion.

name: Orthographic Side
instruction: Create an exact left-side orthographic view in a neutral stance or stable flight posture with no perspective distortion.

name: Orthographic Rear
instruction: Create an exact rear orthographic view showing tail, wing roots, and leg placement with no perspective distortion.

name: Turnaround Sheet
instruction: Create front, left, rear, right, top, and underside views at identical scale and consistent anatomy. No labels.

name: Wing Study
instruction: Show fully spread wings, folded wings, upper and lower surfaces, joint structure, and primary control surfaces.

name: Skeleton Reference
instruction: Show the complete support system with wing joints, flight-muscle attachments, tail support, and landing anatomy. No labels.

name: Flight Musculature
instruction: Show primary flight muscles, secondary control muscles, neck, leg, and tail muscle systems. No labels.

name: Internal Anatomy
instruction: Show respiration, circulation, digestion, sensory systems, reproduction, and flight-specific anatomy in a restrained cutaway. No labels.

name: Lifecycle Sheet
instruction: Show reproductive form, newborn or hatchling, juvenile, adolescent where applicable, mature adult, and elder at comparative scale.

name: Canonical Variants
instruction: Show canonical sex, regional, seasonal, plumage, morph, caste, or engineered variants while preserving core anatomy.

name: Behavior Sheet
instruction: Show idle, perching or resting, feeding, locomotion, social interaction, defensive response, and sleep.

name: Flight and Locomotion Sheet
instruction: Show takeoff, powered flight, glide or soar, banked turn, climb, dive, landing, and ground locomotion where applicable.

name: Native Habitat Scene
instruction: Show the species behaving naturally in its canonical planet and biome, with conditions that explain its flight adaptations.

name: Discovery Scan Source
instruction: Create a centered scientific scan source with restrained contour illumination and no text, labels, or heavy HUD.

name: UI Icon Source
instruction: Create a centered isolated icon with a strong silhouette and readability at 64 pixels.

name: Scale Comparison
instruction: Create a side-view comparison beside a simple unbranded adult human silhouette and one-meter bar. No words or numbers.

name: Master Species Plate
instruction: Create a board with full body, portrait, front, side, rear, top, underside, skeleton, wing anatomy, foot, feeding organ, lifecycle, variants, silhouette, scale, material closeups, and habitat vignette. Unlabeled.

name: Animation Reference Sheet
instruction: Show idle, walk or perch, takeoff, powered flight, glide, turn, dive, feed, interact, defend or attack if canonical, sleep, and death or shutdown.
